title: CLAUDE.md

body.text: guide file Claude Code reads automatically every time it starts work in the project
— put the test command, project structure, conventions, and restrictions in it, so you don't re-explain every session.

example: "CLAUDE.md: 'Run tests: npm test / Use Tailwind, no separate CSS / all components live in src/components'"

title: Write a good CLAUDE.md

body.text: keep it short, only what the AI can't infer, and update it when rules change
— don't include what's already readable from the code; include team rules, restrictions, and project-specific commands.

example: "Include: 'deploy only with ./scripts/deploy.sh' / Don't include: 'this project uses React' (readable from package.json)"
